Apple

Apple, Malus domestica, is a widely cultivated fruit tree from the Rosaceae family.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Susceptible to apple scab, powdery mildew, and fire blight; early signs include leaf spots, wilting, or fungal growth.

Prevention & Treatment: Use resistant varieties, prune infected branches, apply organic fungicides, and maintain proper air circulation.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Thrives in well-drained loamy soil, requires full sunlight, and moderate watering with good drainage.

Harvesting & Yield: Harvest in late summer to early fall when fruits are firm and ripe; average yield varies by variety.

Companion Planting: Grows well with garlic, onions, and marigolds; avoid planting near walnut trees.

Market Value & Uses: Apples are used for fresh consumption, juice, cider, and baked goods; high demand in global markets.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium; deficiency may cause yellowing leaves and reduced fruit quality.

Climate & Region Suitability: Best suited for temperate regions with cold winters and warm summers; common in North America, Europe, and Asia.
Blueberry

Blueberry, Vaccinium spp., is a perennial shrub producing edible berries.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Prone to mummy berry, botrytis blight, and root rot.

Prevention & Treatment: Prune dead branches, maintain air circulation, and use organic fungicides.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Prefers acidic soil (pH 4.5–5.5), full sun, and consistent watering.

Harvesting & Yield: Harvest when berries turn deep blue; yield varies by variety.

Companion Planting: Thrives alongside azaleas, rhododendrons, and heathers.

Market Value & Uses: Consumed fresh, frozen, or used in jams, juices, and baking.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires ammonium sulfate for nitrogen needs.

Climate & Region Suitability: Grows best in cool, moist climates like North America and Europe.
Cherry

Cherry, Prunus avium, is a fruit-bearing tree in the Rosaceae family.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Susceptible to brown rot, leaf spot, and bacterial canker.

Prevention & Treatment: Prune regularly, remove fallen fruit, and apply fungicides.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Prefers deep, well-drained soil, full sunlight, and moderate watering.

Harvesting & Yield: Pick cherries when fully colored and firm; yield varies per variety.

Companion Planting: Best with garlic, onions, and chives; avoid near tomatoes.

Market Value & Uses: Used for fresh eating, preserves, baking, and juicing.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Needs nitrogen and potassium for fruiting.

Climate & Region Suitability: Grows well in temperate climates with cold winters.
Corn

Corn, Zea mays, is a widely grown cereal grain.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Susceptible to smut, common rust, and bacterial wilt.

Prevention & Treatment: Use crop rotation, fungicides, and pest control techniques.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Requires fertile, well-drained soil, full sun, and regular watering.

Harvesting & Yield: Harvest when kernels are milky and fully developed.

Companion Planting: Grows well with beans and squash (Three Sisters planting method).

Market Value & Uses: Used as food, livestock feed, and in biofuel production.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires high nitrogen levels for strong growth.

Climate & Region Suitability: Grows in warm climates with long summers.
Grapes

Grapes, Vitis vinifera, are cultivated for fresh fruit, wine, and raisins.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Prone to powdery mildew, downy mildew, and black rot.

Prevention & Treatment: Apply sulfur-based fungicides, prune regularly, and maintain airflow.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Needs well-drained soil, full sunlight, and trellis support.

Harvesting & Yield: Pick when berries are fully ripe and sweet.

Companion Planting: Compatible with roses and garlic; avoid near cabbage.

Market Value & Uses: Consumed fresh, made into wine, raisins, and vinegar.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires potassium and magnesium for fruit development.

Climate & Region Suitability: Best in Mediterranean climates.
Orange

Orange, Citrus sinensis, is an evergreen tree producing citrus fruit.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Affected by citrus greening, root rot, and canker.

Prevention & Treatment: Use disease-free plants, apply copper fungicides, and improve drainage.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Thrives in sandy loam soil, full sun, and moderate watering.

Harvesting & Yield: Pick when fully orange and firm; yield varies.

Companion Planting: Best with basil, mint, and marigold.

Market Value & Uses: Consumed fresh, juiced, or processed into marmalades.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium.

Climate & Region Suitability: Grows best in subtropical and tropical climates.
Peach

Peach, Prunus persica, is a deciduous tree or shrub grown for its edible fruit.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Susceptible to peach leaf curl, brown rot, and bacterial spot.

Prevention & Treatment: Apply copper fungicides, prune infected branches, and remove fallen leaves.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Prefers well-drained sandy soil, full sun, and regular irrigation.

Harvesting & Yield: Harvest when fruit is firm and slightly soft; yields vary based on variety.

Companion Planting: Thrives with legumes and marigolds; avoid planting near potatoes.

Market Value & Uses: Used fresh, in jams, desserts, and juices; high demand globally.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires nitrogen and potassium for strong fruiting.

Climate & Region Suitability: Best in temperate regions with warm summers.
Pepper Bell

Bell pepper, Capsicum annuum, is an annual or perennial plant cultivated for its edible fruit.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Susceptible to bacterial spot, powdery mildew, and blossom-end rot.

Prevention & Treatment: Use disease-resistant varieties, maintain good air circulation, and apply organic pesticides.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Prefers loamy, well-drained soil, full sunlight, and moderate watering.

Harvesting & Yield: Pick when firm and fully colored; high yields per plant.

Companion Planting: Thrives with carrots, onions, and basil; avoid planting near beans.

Market Value & Uses: Used fresh, in salads, stir-fries, and stuffed dishes.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires phosphorus and calcium for healthy fruiting.

Climate & Region Suitability: Grows best in warm climates with a long growing season.
Potato

Potato, Solanum tuberosum, is an herbaceous perennial plant cultivated for its edible tubers.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Affected by late blight, scab, and fusarium wilt.

Prevention & Treatment: Use disease-free seed potatoes, crop rotation, and fungicides.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Requires well-drained soil, cool temperatures, and consistent moisture.

Harvesting & Yield: Harvest after foliage yellows; high-yielding crop.

Companion Planting: Grows well with beans, corn, and cabbage; avoid planting near tomatoes.

Market Value & Uses: Used in fresh cooking, chips, fries, and industrial starch.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires potassium and phosphorus for strong tuber formation.

Climate & Region Suitability: Thrives in cool climates with moderate rainfall.
Raspberry

Raspberry, Rubus spp., is a fruit-bearing shrub with perennial roots and biennial stems.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Susceptible to raspberry mosaic virus, cane blight, and rust.

Prevention & Treatment: Prune infected canes, improve air circulation, and apply fungicides.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Prefers slightly acidic soil, full sun, and consistent watering.

Harvesting & Yield: Pick when berries are fully colored and detach easily; moderate yield per plant.

Companion Planting: Pairs well with garlic and onions; avoid planting near potatoes.

Market Value & Uses: Used fresh, in jams, desserts, and juices.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires nitrogen and organic mulch for best production.

Climate & Region Suitability: Grows best in temperate regions with mild summers.
Soybean

Soybean, Glycine max, is an annual legume cultivated for its protein-rich seeds.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Susceptible to soybean rust, root rot, and bacterial blight.

Prevention & Treatment: Use disease-resistant varieties, proper crop rotation, and foliar sprays.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Prefers well-drained loamy soil, warm temperatures, and full sunlight.

Harvesting & Yield: Harvest when pods are dry and brown; high-yield legume crop.

Companion Planting: Grows well with corn and cucumbers; avoid planting near onions.

Market Value & Uses: Used in animal feed, tofu, soy milk, and biofuels.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires nitrogen-fixing bacteria to enhance soil fertility.

Climate & Region Suitability: Thrives in warm temperate to tropical climates.
Strawberry

Strawberry, Fragaria × ananassa, is a short herbaceous perennial grown for its sweet fruit.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Susceptible to gray mold, leaf spot, and powdery mildew.

Prevention & Treatment: Mulch with straw, remove infected leaves, and apply organic sprays.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Prefers sandy loam soil, full sun, and regular irrigation.

Harvesting & Yield: Pick when fully red; moderate yield per plant.

Companion Planting: Grows well with spinach and thyme; avoid planting near cabbage.

Market Value & Uses: Used fresh, in smoothies, desserts, and preserves.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires high potassium levels for fruiting.

Climate & Region Suitability: Grows best in mild, temperate climates.
Tomato

Tomato, Lycopersicum esculentum, is an annual vine or bush producing edible fruit.

Common Diseases & Symptoms: Prone to blight, wilt, and tomato mosaic virus.

Prevention & Treatment: Rotate crops, stake plants, and use fungicides.

Ideal Growing Conditions: Prefers well-drained soil, full sun, and moderate watering.

Harvesting & Yield: Pick when fully colored and slightly firm.

Companion Planting: Grows well with basil, carrots, and onions.

Market Value & Uses: Consumed fresh, in sauces, ketchup, and salads.

Fertilization & Nutrient Needs: Requires phosphorus and calcium for strong growth.

Climate & Region Suitability: Grows in warm, sunny climates.
